apps.message:
docs: llms.txt orients and links instead of repeating

## Intent

The catalog's llms.txt held every app, the build steps and the listing steps. It should orient an agent and link to the pages that hold the details.

## Key changes

- The list of apps gives way to a short section "Apps finden": it links the start page with the catalog, names the pattern of the app pages (`<id>/`) and links the English version.
- "Eine App bauen" points to /build/ instead of repeating skill, command and npx block.
- "Eine App eintragen" points to /enter/, the skill lernapps-listing and the fallback form or e-mail, instead of the conditions, the entry template and the pull request steps.
- The entry-point tests expect the skill link and the create command on /build/, no longer in llms.txt.
